name: st
description:
st (simple terminal) is a minimalist terminal emulator for the X Window System developed by suckless.org. Conceived as an antidote to bloated terminal emulators, st prioritizes simplicity, lightness, and speed.

Features:
- Extremely lightweight with near-instantaneous startup times
- Low CPU and RAM resource utilization compared to mainstream terminals
- Full support for 256 colors, truecolor (24-bit RGB), and UTF-8 typography
- Clean, readable C source code easily customizable to specific user needs
- Optimal for tiling window managers and minimalist Unix desktop environments
